key_insight: DeltaTTT shows that, for nonlinear recurrent memory, optimizing each layer separately with state-dependent local targets can be more effective than joint inner-loop updates across the whole memory.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical way to improve sequential test-time adaptation while keeping computation chunkwise-parallel and preserving a nonlinear readout.
method: Replace joint two-layer inner-loop optimization with layerwise learning.
Assign each layer a local prediction target and update it using a delta rule conditioned on current state.
Enable chunkwise parallel computation instead of fully serial adaptation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones, improving both language modeling and retrieval over recurrent baselines.
watch_item: The approach may add optimization design complexity, since each layer needs its own local target and stable state-dependent updates.
paper_title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
